rationale: Prose rewrites for arc C (buyer placement correspondence) and C2 (investor/analyst disclosure). ATT-002 carriers get bodies that match the library version they carry (template v1-v3 vs Bellhaven CPA drafts/executed copies; face, price, dates and change notes from the version vars). Pre-existing subject/attachment defects (684, 631 batch naming; 603 batch 5 vs 6) are named in the body instead of hidden. Buyers ask diligence questions and never state losses or legal conclusions; C2 keeps the 'routine' wording trail (067 on 6/29 -> dropped 7/12 per 200) and separates investor/analyst audiences. Figures come from CSC-CPA-BELLHAVEN figures_ok.

emails.body: Frank — first cut of the buyer placement template attached (v1, dated 5/20). Fair warning, it reads rough. The eligibility representation, the remedies section and governing law are all bracketed for John's team — I didn't want to guess on any of those. Price and the delivery period are blank too, since Priya wants to set those per lot. Mostly sending so you know what buyers will eventually see alongside the approved kit. Please don't circulate yet; it'll change once Legal has been through it.
emails.note: CSC-PLACEMENT-TEMPLATE@v1 (5/20/22): eligibility/remedies/law bracketed; price blank; kit per 177

emails.body: Derek — Tom sent over the v2 placement template and our team has been through it. Three questions before we spend legal time on it. First, the eligibility representation is made in reliance on the Administrator's screening and the Program Documentation — how should we read that in terms of who stands behind eligibility? Second, is replacement-or-refund intended to be the only remedy, or is that still open? Third, the ten business days for certificate delivery — does that run from closing or from funding? Copying Tom since it's his draft.
emails.note: CSC-PLACEMENT-TEMPLATE@v2 (7/18/22): reliance-based eligibility rep, replacement-or-refund remedy, 10 business days, Oregon law; buyer diligence questions only

emails.body: Derek — v3 of the placement template attached. Changes from v2: the remedy is now sole and exclusive and capped at the purchase price, with the survival period still in brackets, and there's a new Offering Jurisdictions section. I've put Oregon and Washington in as placeholders since that's where most of your buyers are. Can you fill in the states you're actually set up to place in, so that section matches your side? I'd like this locked before we formalize anything with you.
emails.note: CSC-PLACEMENT-TEMPLATE@v3 (8/12/22): sole/exclusive remedy capped at price, survival [4 years], Offering Jurisdictions OR/WA placeholders; pre-engagement (008 is 9/2)

emails.body: Robert — first pass at analyst Q&A prep. Expect three questions: why the pause, revenue impact, and restart timing. My recommendation is to keep answers high level: new placements are paused while the company reviews the program, and we'll update when that's done. No restart dates, even informally — analysts will hold you to anything that sounds like a range. On revenue, point to the next quarterly pack rather than giving numbers on a call. Happy to run a mock session Thursday.

Before I circulate, can you confirm finance is comfortable with no revenue figure in the note itself?
